notes: Account: large EU financial data provider building a single-search layer across legal, risk, and client docs (internal + external).
POC summary: ingested ~180M documents -> ~420M embeddings (512-d). Observed tail latencies 150-320ms for topK recall on current vendor (pinecone).
Scale expectations: target index size 1B-2B vectors within 12 months; steady-state QPS 350-1,200 depending on business hour bursts.
Latency targets: 95th <= 80ms for nearest-neighbor fetch + rerank end-to-end for EU region; <150ms on cross-region failover.
Cost sensitivity: target blended cost per query (fetch+ranke) <= $0.0025 currently; would consider higher for critical workflows if SLAs assured.
Model preferences: open-source embeddings (sentence-transformers family) with quantized storage; reranker = small cross-encoder (instruction-tuned) hosted on dedicated GPUs for top-50 rerank.
Residency: strict EU/UK data residency requirement — primary clusters in eu-west-1 (IE) and eu-west-2 (London) with synchronous routing and regional failover. No primary US residency allowed.
Security ask: must pass security questionnaire and provide KMS integration, audit logs for query-level access, SSO/SAML + role-based access, and ISO27001 evidence.
Quote from Head of Search: "We need consistent 60–80ms search response across London and Dublin — anything above that breaks workflows."
Procurement: procurement wants TCO comparison vs current vendor (pinecone) and detailed monthly burn simulation for 1B vectors and 750 qps burst.
Technical risk: reranking cost dominates — want Redwood Optimize recommendations on batching, cache TTLs, and quantization profiles to hit cost targets.
Action items from last call: SE to deliver micro-POC notes with kernel selection + expected GPU counts; AE to attach pricing sheet and latency SLO language.
Internal stakeholder list: Head of Search, CISO (UK), Platform Engineering, Procurement lead. CISO asked for drive link to security FAQ (provided).
